name: Shimeah
overview: Shimeah was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Mikloth. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or detailed narrative provided. His lineage situates him within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin.
namesAndTitles: The name Shimeah means 'he has heard' or 'he is obedient,' reflecting a Hebrew origin and possibly indicating a character trait valued in biblical culture. Another variant of his name, Shimeam, appears in Scripture without a specified meaning, suggesting a slight variation in spelling or pronunciation in different texts.
familyAndRelationships: Shimeah is recorded as the son of Mikloth, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide further family details or additional relationships connected to him.
scriptureSignificance: Shimeah's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, as detailed in 1 Chronicles. His mention helps preserve the lineage and tribal identity important for understanding Israel's history and God's covenant people. Though not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God in maintaining the descendants of Israel.
